newsitem.title: USA: CME March lumber futures tumble near limit down.
newsitem.headline: CME March lumber futures tumble near limit down.

text.p: March CME lumber futures fell for a near limit off $9.90 per thousand board feet as carryover sell stops from Monday's limit decline pushed prices through chart points and touched off further stop loss orders, traders said.
March dropped to $391.50 per tbf and at 0928 CST stood $7.40 lower at $394.00. May was up $1.20 at $375.50 with other months off $1.20 to $3.90.

Continued spreading of long May/short March added to the carryover sell stops in March, which pushed values into further stops under $395. Cash trade remained slow and concern continued over possible increased imports from Canada, traders said.
Canadian mills still need to boost exports to meet their allocations before the end of the quarter and export year under a export agreement which ends March 31.
